result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and continuous sidewalks along the main roadway. Dense vegetation at the corner creates significant visual obstructions that limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing area is provided for pedestrians, forcing them to cross an unmarked roadway with no priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense trees and shrubs at the corner obscure sightlines for both pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection corner

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of a paved sidewalk along the main road forces pedestrians to walk in the grass or the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right foreground along the main road

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a safe, accessible, and visible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove obstructing vegetation near the corner to improve visibility and sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks along the main roadway to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

result.summary: This residential street lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, with no visible sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicular traffic, which is a significant safety concern in a residential area.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the street alongside vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the scene.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the wide residential street.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear on the asphalt surface.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections or key mid-block locations to improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential zone.

result.summary: This residential street features sidewalks but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible, creating an environment where pedestrians must navigate unmarked crossings with potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted markings to designate a pedestrian crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The corner lacks ADA-compliant curb ramps, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition

hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
